1418-1586-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1418-1586-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Silver Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Silver Drake enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2872-4828-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2872-4828-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1981-2415-4050-6578.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
1981-2415-4050-6578.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

3591-7841-8089.description:
Activate Necropotence by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

618-4050-6132.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic with haste.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

851-3129-4826-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1308-4365-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1479-2841-6155-7892.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-6155-7892.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

4200-6867-6967-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

372-5895-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Splash Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-5895-7487.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

433-3259-5621--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
433-3259-5621--85--106.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
Arid Archway enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1978-6893-7290.description:
Animate The Eternity Elevator using Does Machines.
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat from step 2.
1978-6893-7290.notes: You can tap The Eternity Elevator for colored mana instead if able to do so.

489-586-3967-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1692-4365-7150.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Resolve the copy of the Helm of the Host trigger, creating two token copies of Kirol that aren't legendary.
Holding priority, activate the Kirol token by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

483-5073-5220-6900.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

38-3025-5220-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

586-5626-6112-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Fumulus's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Insect and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

970-1656-2275-3260.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Asmodeus's first ability by paying {B/P}{B/P}{B/P}, causing you to draw seven cards.
Shabraz triggers seven times, causing you to gain 7 life and put seven +1/+1 counters on Shabraz.
Repeat.

3043-3812-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures with defender.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3043-3812-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Axebane Guardian's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3705-4050-4094-5997.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
3705-4050-4094-5997.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating two 2/2 Alien Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warriors, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1486-2494-3459-5929.description:
Activate Dwarven Bloodboiler by tapping Battered Golem.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Resolve the Dwarven Bloodboiler ability, giving target creature +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

930-1591-3781-4659.description:
Cast Universal Automaton from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
When Universal Automaton dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Resolve the Zask trigger, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

1742-5184-5742-5743.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Gilded Assault Cart, adding {B}.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

656-1881-5220.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Ugin's Conjurant on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

659-728-3746.notablePrerequisites:
Robaran Mercenaries does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two Goblins.
659-728-3746.description:
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Krenko's ability by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Grimgrin's ability by sacrificing a Goblin, untapping Robaran Mercenaries and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1339-1462-1758.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-1462-1758.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Eidolon of Blossoms, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
